A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' was the partner of the criminal [[Artagan Truax]]. At one point, the two joined the fanatical [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] cult and became parents to a boy named [[Eogan Truax|Eogan]]. However, around [[49 BBY/Legends|49 BBY]], while Eogan was still an infant, the mother died. Artagan remained with the Bando Gora for some time, until he learned of the cult's planned murder of [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Iram Radique]]. Artagan, Eogan and Radique then fled from the cult.
